description: FIND-013 PARTIAL. _HUMAN_BODY_PHRASES was extended from 7 → ~17 phrases including 'human-in-the-loop', '@dais', 'human required', 'please review', 'human approval', 'ask the owner', 'owner-only', 'manual approval', 'user input required'. STILL missed: (a) Japanese phrases — 'デイスさん' / 'デイス' / 'ダイスケ' / 'ダイスさん' / 'お願いします' / '見てください' — the blocklist is ASCII-only despite Dais being a Japanese-named owner and the codebase routinely using Japanese. (b) Mixed-language tokens — 'Daisuke-san' / 'Dais-sama'. (c) Indirect surfaces — 'open a ticket', 'page the operator', 'wake up the owner', 'check with the team'. PROP-B4 (required:true) coverage is still bypassable by a sibling AI authoring in Japanese.

evidence.snippet:
_HUMAN_BODY_PHRASES = [
    "dais", "owner please", "human", ...
    "human-in-the-loop", "humanintheloop", "@dais", "human required", ...
    "owner-only", "manual approval", "user input required",
]
